publicPage.intro: What anybody with your link sees: your picture, your number, and whether they can book.
publicPage.noBranch: Pick a branch to edit its public page.

cover.title: Cover photo
cover.help: The picture on your card in the app and at the top of your public page. Cropped to the same 4:3 frame as a dish.

phone.label: Phone
phone.help: Published on the page. International format, like +374 11 22 33 44. Leave empty to publish no number.

bookings.label: Take bookings from the public page
bookings.help: Off until you switch it on. While it is off the page still shows the room, the menu and the hours, and simply offers no booking.

publicPage.failed: That did not save. Nothing changed — try again.

listing.title: In the Yalla app
listing.intro: What diners read on your card and your page in the app. It has its own save button, apart from the settings above.

cuisine.label: Cuisine
cuisine.help: One line, like “Armenian & Mediterranean”. Up to 120 characters.

about.label: About
about.help: A short paragraph about the place. Up to 2000 characters.

website.label: Website
website.help: The full address, starting with https://. Leave empty to show none.

location.title: Map pin
location.help: Where the app puts you on the map and measures distance from. Decimal degrees, like 40.1843 and 44.5129.
location.bothOrNeither: Enter both latitude and longitude, or leave both empty to keep the current pin.
location.notANumber: Enter each coordinate as a decimal number, like 40.1843.
location.outOfRange: Latitude must be between -90 and 90, and longitude between -180 and 180. Check they are not swapped.

gallery.title: Gallery
gallery.help: Photos shown after the cover, in this order. Up to {{max}}.
gallery.full: The gallery is full. Remove a photo to add another.

listing.failed: The listing did not save. Nothing changed — try again.
listing.photoMissing: One of the gallery photos was not uploaded for this branch. Remove it and upload it again.

address.label: Street address
address.help: Shown to diners with the map pin. Change them together.
address.required: Enter the address together with the map pin.

listing.relocateOwnerOnly: Only an owner can move the map pin or change the address.

priceLevel.range: Pick a price level from {{min}} to {{max}}.

websiteUrl.scheme: The website must start with http:// or https://.
websiteUrl.tooLong: The website address can be at most {{max}} characters.

cuisine.tooLong: The cuisine can be at most {{max}} characters.

about.tooLong: The description can be at most {{max}} characters.

galleryPhotoIds.tooMany: The gallery can hold at most {{max}} photos.
galleryPhotoIds.duplicate: The same photo is in the gallery twice.

amenities.unknown: One of the amenities is not recognised. Reload the page and try again.

coordinates.pair: Enter both latitude and longitude, or neither.

photoXY.pair: A table pin is missing one of its two coordinates. Place the table again.
photoXY.range: A table pin is outside the photo. Place the table again.

address.tooLong: The address can be at most {{max}} characters.

errors.generic: Something in the form was not accepted. Check the fields and try again.

markers.title: Tables on the cover photo
markers.intro: Diners tap a table on your cover photo to book it. Pick a table, then click where it is in the picture. Drag a pin to move it.
markers.noCover: Save a cover photo above first — the tables are placed on it.
markers.noTables: This branch has no tables yet. Add them in the floor plan editor.
markers.stage: Cover photo. Click to place the selected table.
markers.selected: Placing table {{label}}. Click the photo, or use the arrow keys on its pin.
markers.pickTable: Pick a table from the list to place it.
markers.failed: The positions did not save. Nothing changed — try again.
markers.selectedUnplaced: Table {{label}} is not on the photo yet. Click where it is in the picture, or place it in the middle and move its pin with the arrow keys.
markers.refused: The floor plan was refused — a table in use is missing, or two tables share a label. Fix it in the floor plan editor, then save the positions again.
markers.discarded: The cover photo changed, so the pin changes you had not saved were discarded.
markers.coverChanged: The cover photo was changed somewhere else, so these positions were not saved. The new cover is shown now — place the tables on it again.

forbidden.title: You don't have access to this
forbidden.body: This page either does not exist or is not part of what your account covers. Nothing was changed.
forbidden.back: Back to where you can go

venues.title: Venues

empty.title: No venues match that
empty.body: Try a different name, or clear the search.
empty.first: No venues yet. Add the first one.

venues.error: We could not load the venues. Try again.

venue.notFound: That venue could not be found.
venue.suspendBody: Diners stop seeing it and staff cannot open new tabs. Nothing is lost, and you can undo this at any time.
venue.deleteBody: This hides the venue everywhere. Its history is kept, but nobody can reach it. Type the venue name to confirm.

blocked.title: Still in service
blocked.body: This venue cannot be deleted while a table is mid-service. Close these tabs first:
blocked.unknown: A table is still mid-service. The server did not say which.

venue.failed: That did not go through. Nothing changed — try again.
venue.staffFailed: Could not load this venue’s staff. Try again.

tier.notReady_one: {{count}} dish is not ready to show a diner. Finish the menu, then switch.
tier.notReady_other: {{count}} dishes are not ready to show a diner. Finish the menu, then switch.

create.title: Add a venue
create.lead: A venue and its first branch are created together. A venue with no branch has no floor, no menu and no tables, so it cannot be onboarded.
create.name: Venue name

error.slugTaken: "{{slug}}" is already in use. Pick another.
error.generic: We could not create that. Nothing was saved.
error.addressRequired: Give the branch a street address.
error.pinRequired: Give the branch a map pin — both latitude and longitude.
error.pinRange: That map pin is not a real place. Latitude is between -90 and 90, longitude between -180 and 180.
error.branchSlugRequired: Give the branch a web address. A name written only in Armenian or Russian cannot become one on its own.

create.pinHint: The map pin diners are sent to. Right-click the spot in Google Maps and copy the two numbers.

state.offline: You are offline. Check the connection and try again.
state.notAvailable: This is not available from the backend yet.
state.signedOut: Your session ended. Sign in again.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.body: Use the email and password for your venue account.
signIn.failed: That email and password do not match an account.
signIn.expired: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue where you were.

resetPassword.title: Choose a password
resetPassword.body: This is the password you will sign in to the venue console with.
resetPassword.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
resetPassword.doneBody: Sign in with your email and the password you just chose.
resetPassword.invalidTitle: This link is no longer valid
resetPassword.invalidBody: Ask the person who sent it for a new one.
resetPassword.signedInBody: This link is for someone else. Opening it here would use it up. Send it on.

floorPlan.noBranch: This account has no branch to draw a plan for.

properties.title: Properties
properties.none: Select a table to edit it.

areas.title: Floor areas
areas.none: No areas yet. Tables can sit in none.

row.title: Add a row of tables
row.body: Twelve identical two-tops along a wall, in one go.
row.overruns: That run does not fit inside the room. Shorten it, or make the room bigger first.

qr.title: QR code
qr.pending: This table gets its code when the plan is saved.
qr.regenerateWarning: The code printed and stuck to table {{label}} stops working the moment this lands. Somebody has to go and replace it.

deactivated.body: Table {{label}} has bookings against it, so it was kept and deactivated rather than deleted.

error.outsideCanvas: This table sits outside the room.
error.duplicateLabel: Another table already uses this label.
error.willBeRejected: These tables sit outside the room and the save will be refused: {{labels}}.
error.duplicates: These labels are used more than once: {{labels}}.

result.deactivated: Kept and deactivated because they have bookings: {{labels}}.

preview.title: What a diner sees
preview.body: The real viewer at phone width. Check the labels survive, and whether the room is dense enough to split into areas.

conflict.title: Someone else changed the floor plan
conflict.body: A newer version was saved while you were editing, so your changes were not saved. Reload to see it; your unsaved changes here will be lost.

menu.noBranch: Your account is not attached to a branch.

category.title: Categories
category.emptyHint: Start with a category — “Coffee”, say, or “Hot dishes”.
category.confirmWithItems: Delete “{{name}}”? Its {{count}} dishes go with it — they are not moved to another category.
category.inUse: One of this category's dishes is already on an order, so nothing was deleted. Mark those dishes sold out instead.

item.title: Dishes
item.dinerAsksTitle: What a diner would otherwise ask a waiter
item.dinerAsksBody: These are required. They are the reason a diner stops having to ask — without them the ordering feature is not worth much.

field.name: Name
field.priceHint: Whole dram. Changing a price never affects lines already ordered.
field.prepHint: The diner sees this as an estimate at order time.

incomplete.label: Not finished yet
incomplete.body_one: {{count}} dish is not ready to show a diner. Ordering cannot be switched on until it is.
incomplete.body_other: {{count}} dishes are not ready to show a diner. Ordering cannot be switched on until they are.
incomplete.noneHere: Everything in this category is finished.

photo.dropHere: Drop a photo here, or click to choose one
photo.accepted: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 8 MB
photo.variantCard: Card size — this is what a diner looks at
photo.tooLarge: That photo is larger than 8 MB. Export it smaller and try again.
photo.badDimensions: Those dimensions will not work as a card.
photo.wrongFormat: That file is not a JPEG, PNG or WebP.
photo.wrongFormatDetected: The file name says one thing and the bytes say another: this is really a {{format}}. Export it as a JPEG and try again.

bulk.title: Photos in bulk
bulk.body: Drop the whole set. Names are matched against dishes, and nothing is attached until you confirm it.
bulk.noneMatched: Nothing matched by name. Place them by hand below.
bulk.trayBody: Camera filenames match nothing. Pick a dish for each.

hours.body: The whole week saves at once. Crossing midnight is worked out for you — a closing time before the opening time means the next day.
hours.saveFailed: Could not save the opening hours.
hours.split: Split the day (a lunch break, say)
hours.sameEveryDayHint: Copies Monday onto every other day.
hours.overlapWarning: Two spans on the same day overlap. Fix the marked rows before saving.

policy.serviceChargeNote: The service charge appears on every diner's bill as its own line, from the first item. It is snapshotted onto a tab when the tab opens, so changing it does not affect tabs already open.

booking.title: How far ahead people can book
booking.body: How far the calendar opens, and how late a booking can still be made.

holding.title: How long a table is held
holding.body: These decide how many bookings fit on one table in an evening.

lateness.title: When somebody is late
lateness.body: Nothing is cancelled automatically. These decide when staff are prompted.

approval.title: What needs a person
approval.body: A booking is either confirmed straight away or it waits for you.

money.title: What goes on the bill
money.body: Both of these are visible to every diner.

turnTimeMinutes.label: How long a table is held
turnTimeMinutes.why: How long a table is kept for a booking. It is why a diner is told “available 18:00 – 19:45”.

bufferMinutes.label: Turnaround between bookings
bufferMinutes.why: Extra time between two bookings for clearing the table. Not shown to the diner.

walkInHoldbackMinutes.label: Walk-in warning window
walkInHoldbackMinutes.why: How close to a booking a walk-in may still be seated before staff are warned.

maxSeatOverhang.label: People over the seat count
maxSeatOverhang.why: How many more than a table seats may be sat at it. Five at a four-top is normal.

graceMinutes.label: How long a late party keeps the table
graceMinutes.why: How long past the booked time the table is still theirs before it may be released.

lateNudgeAfterMinutes.label: When to ask if they are coming
lateNudgeAfterMinutes.why: How long past the start before the diner is asked to confirm they are on their way.

graceExtensionMinutes.label: What “we're on our way” buys
graceExtensionMinutes.why: How much longer one tap from the diner keeps the table.

minLeadMinutes.label: Shortest notice
minLeadMinutes.why: How close to a slot a booking may still be made. Thirty minutes means a 19:00 table cannot be booked at 18:45.

bookingWindowDays.label: How far ahead the calendar goes
bookingWindowDays.why: How far into the future a diner can book.

cancellationDeadlineMinutes.label: Free cancellation deadline
cancellationDeadlineMinutes.why: How long before the booking a diner may cancel without it going on their record.

autoConfirm.label: Confirm bookings automatically
autoConfirm.why: Off sends every booking to you to approve.

approvalRequiredAbovePartySize.label: Party size that needs approval
approvalRequiredAbovePartySize.why: Parties above this wait for you even when automatic confirmation is on.

serviceChargePercent.label: Service charge
serviceChargePercent.why: Added to every bill as its own line, from the first item.

pricesIncludeVat.label: Prices include VAT
pricesIncludeVat.why: Affects how the bill is presented, nothing else.

affected.label: Existing bookings
affected.body_one: {{count}} existing booking no longer fits the new rules.
affected.body_other: {{count}} existing bookings no longer fit the new rules.
affected.explain: They were not changed and not cancelled — a settings edit never rewrites a booking. The new rules apply to future bookings only.

checklist.title: What is still needed
checklist.body: This branch can take diners once all of this is done. The order does not matter.

reports.intro: How the week went, and what is worth changing.
reports.rangeTooLong: A report covers at most {{max}} days. Narrow the range.
reports.partialRange: Nothing was recorded before {{date}} in this range.

range.backwards: The end date is before the start date.

export.failed: That file could not be downloaded. Try again.

empty.title: No data in this range
empty.body: Try a wider range. This does not mean the venue took nothing — there is simply nothing recorded on these days.

occupancy.title: Occupancy
occupancy.blurb: When the room fills, and how long people actually stay.

turnTime.title: Actual turn time against policy
turnTime.blurb: A distribution, not an average. A fast lunch and a slow dinner average to a number that describes neither.
turnTime.noSittings: No sittings closed in this range.
turnTime.overPolicy: The middle sitting runs {{median}} minutes against a policy of {{policy}} — {{overBy}} minutes longer. {{percent}}% of sittings run past the policy, so the system is refusing bookings the table could actually have taken.
turnTime.withinPolicy: The middle sitting runs {{median}} minutes, inside the {{policy}}-minute policy. {{percent}}% of sittings run past it.

reservations.title: Reservations
reservations.blurb: How many were booked, and what became of them.

noApp.title: Web bookings without an app
noApp.blurb: These guests cannot be reminded. No app means no push channel, so the reminder, the late nudge and one-tap cancel never reach them. This is the number that decides whether SMS is worth paying for.
noApp.label: No way to reach them

leadTime.title: How far ahead people book
leadTime.reading: This is the distribution the booking window should be set from.

menu.title: Menu
menu.blurb: What sold, what did not, and what got sent back.
menu.noneSold: Nothing was ordered in this range.

neverOrdered.blurb: A dish nobody orders is inventory, prep time and menu space. Tap a name to open it in the editor.
neverOrdered.none: Everything on the menu sold in this range.

voids.title: Voided lines
voids.blurb: A dish voided often is either mis-described on the menu or badly made.

revenue.title: Revenue
revenue.blurb: What was taken, by day and by hour.

adjustments.title: Comps and discounts
adjustments.none: Nothing was comped or discounted in this range.

staff.intro: Who works here, and which devices they sign in on.
staff.noVenue: This account is not attached to a venue.

empty.title: Nobody here yet
empty.body: Without staff, nobody can sign in to the counter screen.

field.name: Full name
field.emailHelp: They open a link and choose their own password. Nobody types one for them.

ownPin.title: Change my PIN
ownPin.help: Type a new 4-digit PIN for the tablets, twice. It is not shown anywhere.
ownPin.mismatch: The two PINs do not match.
ownPin.changedBody: Use it the next time you sign in on a tablet.

pin.help: Personal. There are no shared PINs — a shared one makes "who gave away my table" unanswerable.
pin.shownOnceBody: Shown now and never again. After this it can only be replaced, not looked up.
pin.neverShared: Everyone has their own. Do not write it on the till.

signIn.emailRequired: Enter the address they will sign in with.
signIn.emailTooLong: An email address is at most 320 characters.
signIn.addressChanges: From the moment you send this they sign in with {{email}} instead of {{old}}; their password stays the same.
signIn.tooManyRequests: Too many links issued in the last minute. Wait a moment, then try again.
signIn.linkBody: Paste it to them in a chat. They open it and choose their own password — nobody types one for them.
signIn.onceOnly: Shown now and never again. If it is lost, send a new one — the old one stops working.
signIn.keepsPassword: Their current password keeps working until they open this.
signIn.copyFirst: Copy the link first, or press Done.
signIn.notIssued: Added, but without a sign-in link:

roleInfo.owner: Runs the venue: every branch, the staff and the settings.
roleInfo.manager: Runs the floor plan, menu and staff for their branch.
roleInfo.waiter: Takes orders and seats tables on the counter tablet, with a PIN.
roleInfo.kitchen: Sees and updates orders on the kitchen screen, with a PIN.

wizard.roleHelp: This decides what they can see and do.
wizard.coOwnerNote: A co-owner is added with a PIN. Their console sign-in is issued by the Yalla team.
wizard.pinShownAgain: You'll see it once more after adding, to read out to them.
wizard.signInAfter: After you press Add, the link appears once, for you to paste to them.

staffId.label: Staff ID
staffId.help: Needed only to sign in on a tablet that cannot load the staff list. Copy it and send it to them.

devices.title: Tablets
devices.blurb: The tablets the counter screen runs on.
devices.empty: No devices enrolled at this branch.
devices.grantsNothing: A device grants nothing on its own — every action still needs a PIN on top. A stolen tablet is not a stolen till.

code.instructions: Type this code on the tablet to enrol it.
code.onceOnly: One use only. Lose it and generate another — the old one cannot be looked up.

confirm.title: Revoke {{name}}?
confirm.body: {{name}} stops working immediately. If that is the tablet in service, the counter screen goes offline.
confirm.permanent: Permanent. A device that turns up again is enrolled afresh.

approvals.title: Awaiting approval
approvals.body: Bookings the policy stopped. Nothing is promised to the diner until somebody here decides.
approvals.reasonHint: Recorded on the booking. The diner is told it was declined, not why.
approvals.failed: Could not record the decision. Try again.
approvals.offline: You are offline. The decision was not sent.

steps.acceptsWebBookingsOptional: Optional. With it off, diners still see the room, the menu and the hours, but cannot book.

blockers.title: What stops diners using this branch
blockers.ready: This branch is ready for diners.
blockers.floorPlanEmpty: The floor plan has no tables on it yet.
blockers.tablesUnlabelled: Some tables have no label yet.
blockers.menuNoCategories: The menu has no categories yet.
blockers.menuNoItems: The menu has categories but no dishes.
blockers.menuIncomplete_one: {{count}} dish is missing a photo, a description, ingredients, allergens, a portion size or a prep time, and is hidden from diners until it is finished.
blockers.menuIncomplete_other: {{count}} dishes are missing a photo, a description, ingredients, allergens, a portion size or a prep time, and are hidden from diners until they are finished.
blockers.hoursNotSet: Opening hours have not been set.
blockers.policyNotReviewed: Nobody has reviewed the reservation policy yet; it is still on the defaults.
blockers.noStaff: No staff work at this branch yet.
blockers.noDevice: No tablet has been enrolled at this branch yet.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.reasonRequired: Give a reason for hiding this review.
reviews.empty: This branch has no reviews yet.
reviews.failed: That did not go through. Nothing changed — try again.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.reasonRequired: Give a reason for hiding this review.
reviews.platformHidden: Hidden by the Yalla team. Only they can show it again.
reviews.failed: That did not go through. Nothing changed — try again.
